scope.coverage_boundary: H01-H32 preserve the initial donor/research families; H33 appends the 2026-10-18 source/build/kernel license-boundary obligation. This is a planned catalog, not implemented or passing tests; UC/G and capability-specific obligations also apply.

selection_policy.rule: Select applicable cases/subcases and tiers from the advertised operation and support claims before environment discovery. Missing required prerequisites/results remain incomplete.
selection_policy.candidate_applicability: Candidate consumer mappings are proposed impact/CI selection inputs, not evidence of adopted implementation, complete donor coverage or current test qualification.
before_porting: Resolve the donor alias to the exact selected full source SHA and relevant WIP/dirty hashes using the cited donor inventory.
Record provenance/license and identify the concrete defect/subcase accepted by the new contract.
Instantiate independent workload/fixture truth, positive and active excluded controls, and the named bad-control assertion.
Bind future results to exact candidate library/features/backend/object/profile/fixture/suite versions; do not reuse historical donor receipts for changed bytes.
selection_policy.oracle_boundary: Expected truth must be authored from independent fixture/workload/reference semantics; never copy the observer actual value or use same-engine round trip as sole oracle. Coherent custom-backend assertions retain their own provenance and cannot mint trusted Linux authority.
selection_policy.sensitivity_boundary: A bad control is killed only when the named assertion is reached after setup and trigger verification; repeat a restored valid twin. It is not enough that the run crashes or times out.
selection_policy.component_boundary: The file-only pilot does not wait for unrelated BPF/native features and does not complete the requested ready mapped-image package. Mapping readiness also requires the applicable UC real environment, policy and installed delivery obligations.
selection_policy.donor_coverage_boundary: Inspected anchors establish only the named implementation/test/research source. No complete-family coverage, fresh test pass, extracted implementation or current-byte qualification follows. An anchor with alias null preserves an explicitly unresolved source-root association rather than guessing a product pin.

selection_order: Declare the supported operation, semantic strength, consumers and environment profile.
Select applicable H/UC/G obligations and name their concrete subcases.
Fix each subcase required tiers/cells, independent oracle, bad control, non-vacuity and cleanup criteria.
Then discover or provision admitted environments and run the plan.
tier_and_cell_planning.unavailable_required_cell: Remain BLOCKED/NOT_RUN/incomplete; do not remove a cell, narrow a claim silently or count a refusal as successful live capability solely because the environment is unavailable.
tier_and_cell_planning.live_claim_rule: Any advertised load/verifier/attachment/producer behavior, kernel ordering or live closure claim requires the corresponding T4 cell and semantic evidence. Host/model/object evidence cannot discharge that live obligation. A purely host or object claim does not inherit unrelated T4 gates.
tier_and_cell_planning.plan_changes: Changing claims or required cells is an explicit versioned plan change, never an automatic environment-dependent downgrade.

cross_cutting_delivery_gate.required_when: Delivering any selected Rust or native package/component/adapter/profile, including those whose H family inventory lacks T5.
cross_cutting_delivery_gate.required_evidence: Applicable contracts run through the actual downstream/package surface and installed or source-free route specified by the selected delivery claim, with exact library/features/backend/fixture/suite identities and the independently authored oracle. The selected component acceptance also retains its real consumer integration requirements.
cross_cutting_delivery_gate.scope: Rust delivery is priority one. Native C/Mojo adapter delivery remains later unless explicitly selected; listing a later native profile does not gate the first Rust component.
cross_cutting_delivery_gate.h13_clarification: Installed Rust transport/staging adapters require T5 just as selected native adapters do; H13 T5 is not restricted to C/Mojo or cross-language use.
cross_cutting_delivery_gate.not_sufficient_alone: T5 complements and does not replace applicable T0-T4 or real filesystem/namespace cells.
